host.description: UniFi OS / Protect controller host. Injected from the credential rule (controller host override or the SRQL target). Never entered on the plugin assignment form.

username.description: Local UniFi OS account. Stored on a username/password credential secret, not on this assignment.

password.description: Local UniFi OS password. Stored on a credential secret, not on this assignment.

api_key.description: UniFi OS API key. Stored on an API-key credential secret, not on this assignment.

cookie.description: Optional pre-provisioned Cookie header. Do not paste session cookies into plugin assignment.

scheme.description: http or https. UniFi OS almost always uses https.

insecure_skip_verify.description: Allow the controller's self-signed TLS certificate. Set this on the credential rule TLS policy (skip_verify) rather than here when possible.

discover_streams.description: Discover RTSP stream profiles from bootstrap

collect_events.description: Collect a bounded Protect websocket event sample

event_sources.description: Protect event source selector; current plugin uses the updates feed

bootstrap_path.description: Protect bootstrap path on UniFi OS. Default /proxy/protect/api/bootstrap.

rtsp_port.description: Protect RTSP/RTSPS relay port (7447, or 7441 on some controllers)
